title: Reproducibility code for near-field CRB in unknown colored noise
description: Reproducibility code, fixed experiment configurations, and frozen numerical results for the manuscript "Near-Field CRB for a Quasi-Stationary Source in Unknown Colored Noise" by Xin Lu. Includes Profile ML, Werner-Jansson WSF, multi-state allocation, near-field Fisher-information checks, and diffuse-field model-mismatch experiments. No article manuscript or third-party audio is distributed.
